ui.note: An open, visible, unlocked key holder fulfills pending workspace file-grant requests on the 15-second state cadence with backoff on failure and a bounded pass, never alongside a reconcile, skips requests another holder already won, pauses while hidden and stops on lock, sign-out and unmount. A member selection waiting for its grant checks its own request for up to ten minutes and uploads once the key arrives, only to the workspace and task or comment where it was picked, with the comment text captured at Send; a resume the user triggers, such as after key rotation, posts the draft as it stands, and a task change clears the composer's picked files. Moving elsewhere or the time limit stops the wait with a visible message in all six locales. Grant checks, sealing and server authorization are unchanged; no theme change.

release.note: Prepare second beta 0.1.0-beta.2/Android code 14 after published 0.1.0-beta.1; retain signing certificate, documentation epoch, remaining prerelease/native limits and prerelease publication wording. Add ditero-VERSION-clients.tar.gz with CLI/MCP/TUI JavaScript bundles, notices, per-file checksums, BUILDINFO and provenance attestation verified with a read-only attestations token. Packaging qualifies current and minimum Bun. Reject missing bundles/checksums/notices/attestation, bundled packages absent from notices, home/build paths, private-looking hosts/addresses, environment content, common secret shapes and build identity without building Bun. Standalone executables remain deferred; existing assets/signing/stable promotion rules remain. Packaging validates the Kustomize example as exactly two tag-matched image overrides. macOS desktop packaging retries at most three attempts total, only on the hdiutil eject-busy signature after detaching leftover dmg volumes and removing stale rw images; other failures and non-macOS failures exit immediately.

configuration.note: Helm chart/appVersion, default app/Zero tags and Kustomize labels/images/overrides move to 0.1.0-beta.2 with no value or format changes. Align Zero client/cache at 1.11.1, upstream Litestream configurations/forks and V5 backup defaults; retain app IDs, publications, slots and restricted roles, and document connection budgets and upgrade order. Add optional GOOGLE_, MICROSOFT_, GITHUB_, DISCORD_, FACEBOOK_, APPLE_, DITERO_OIDC_ and DITERO_SAML_* settings with _FILE forms, defaults and failure behavior; providers are off by default. Retain the explicit Compose Zero tag override and release suffix default. Kustomize gates Zero on the app build through commit comparison against app health, replacing the manual zero-replica hold. Missing/empty commits fail closed; local images need the same build commit. Overrides require exactly two tag-matched image names/replacement tags without extra fields. Document Kubernetes logical restore with original credentials, ciphertext and fresh Zero cache. Existing Helm values and stored formats remain unchanged; revert manifests for rollback. Focus clocks live in migration-owned server_private with runtime USAGE and SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only, outside default and explicit public Zero publications. Retain runtime/migrator shard grants.

deployment.note: Published defaults move to 0.1.0-beta.2; upgrades from beta.1 need no migration or cache rebuild. Rebuild Zero and optional all-in-one runtime from the aligned reviewed package and PostgreSQL patch, preserving pinned Node and hardened backup dependencies while adding V5 configuration and replica migration/restore guidance. Compose/all-in-one pass optional social/OIDC settings; Helm uses extraEnv. SAML settings pass through Compose and the all-in-one bundle (file forms only there), with read-only key/certificate/metadata mounts. Defaults remain disabled. Preserve published Compose/Helm/Kustomize recovery guidance: database-first blob snapshots, original secrets, CNPG managed roles/logical restore and bounded diagnostics before cleanup. Kustomize automatically enforces app-before-Zero startup like Helm; alpha.12 upgrades remove manual hold patches. Retain the Compose Zero image override and existing release defaults; provider settings do not alter volumes or rollback procedures. Compose/CNPG initialize the private focus schema and restricted grants. Develop upgrades retain Zero caches; only earlier local branch caches containing public clocks need rebuilding.

native.note: Native sync follows the bundled Zero 1.11.1 client: Android and desktop accept exactly /sync/v53/connect on the configured Zero origin (was v51, so beta.1 native apps never opened a sync socket) and relay inbound binary poke chunks up to 1 MiB to the page as base64, rebuilt as ArrayBuffers; malformed frames end the socket, an oversized frame gives the page one abnormal close before any later frame, and the page still sends text frames only. A pin test reads the installed Zero client and fails when either native path or inbound bound drifts. Grant, session, JWT splicing, refusal fences and canonical HTTPS checks are unchanged; no migration, storage or server change.

authentication.note: Preserve the Better Auth 1.7.12 upgrade, JWT/provider-account migrations, explicit provider linking, nonce validation, verified-email admission and scoped Apple origin checks. Reset atomically consumes its token, writes the password, verifies the mailbox and retires sessions, native authority, access tokens, feeds, passkeys, provider links and pending account proofs while retaining TOTP and backup codes. Enforce the enrolled local factor on every sign-in path, including social/OIDC/SAML callbacks, passkeys and native system-browser flows. Reuse the plugin challenge, provisional-session deletion and reset invalidation. Provider MFA and remembered-device cookies cannot substitute. Native grants retain their ID and stay unapproved until successful factor completion and explicit consent; no bridge permissions or credential formats change. Upgrade server/web together and reload sign-in pages; rollback loses this protection.

compatibility.note: Better Auth adds nullable jwks.alg/crv and a duplicate-checked unique provider-account index, preserving encrypted Ed25519 keys and restricted roles. Zero 1.11.1 retains durable close/outage retry, acknowledgement/unknown-result guards and bounded predecessor retirement while server replicas migrate incrementally; 1.9 clients create fresh local databases and must drain unsent mutations first. Storage failures retain accepted mutations for server acknowledgement. Provider-content version 2 bindings validate dateOrder, anchorDay and nesting bounds while reusing version 1 intermediates/planner 4/writer/notification activation. Password reset also revokes SAML pending-link intents. Native/legacy import contracts remain. Existing attachment ciphertext/quotas and membership-leave cleanup remain unchanged; no TEMP grants are needed. Desktop protected credentials use bounded records/journals; earlier evidence needs online refresh. Focus migrations 0088/0089/0090 add IDs-only synced acknowledgements and move RLS-protected clocks to server_private outside Zero publications. Exclusive spans require full server-observed duration plus pauses; new starts close preceding spans. Auto-cycle waits for completion replay; unqualified observers cannot discard another tab proof opportunity even at per-interval reconciliation expiry. Evidence expires after 14 days; leader cleanup deletes at most 500 expired pairs per tick through a migration-owned fixed-bound function.
compatibility.upgrade: Drain every browser/native Zero 1.9 queue before replacing clients; keep offline clients on their old bundle until drained. Check/repair duplicate provider accounts, stop app and Zero, back up the matching recovery set and run additive better_auth_jwks, account_provider_unique and import-binding migrations as migration owner. Retain restricted NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS credentials, publications and slots. Start updated Zero before 1.11 clients and verify replica catch-up. Retain additive membership-leave migration, attachment directory permissions and original authentication secret. Earlier desktop evidence needs one complete online start. Apply focus migrations 0088/0089/0090 with Zero stopped, verify private grants, reload clients and start fresh intervals; older overlapping evidence is invalidated without rewriting sessions. Upgrades from develop need NO cache rebuild. Only earlier local branch caches containing public clocks need rebuilding; verify fresh sync and publication exclusion.
compatibility.backup: Keep coordinated PostgreSQL, attachment ciphertext, original encryption keys and authentication secret as one recovery set. Retain Zero replica snapshots and legacy/V5 backups through rollback and test V5 restore. Keep provider exports private for fresh preview. OS credential records are outside server backups; sign in online after server restore. Restore focus acknowledgement/private clock tables together with schema grants. Missing, expired or superseded evidence rejects server-proof completions; saved browser flags never authorize offline fallback.
compatibility.rollback: Drain 1.11 queues and downgrade clients before Zero; use a fresh disposable old cache, since 1.9 cannot read V5 backup paths. Preserve authoritative PostgreSQL. Better Auth 1.6.23 tolerates added nullable columns/index; retain additive migrations. Resume/discard new provider binding plans with the updated app before downgrade and stop new imports. Disable new providers without deleting their rows. Older desktop builds require sign-out/OS credential cleanup. Restore snapshots only with matching secrets/ciphertext and account for newer data loss; reverse secret rotation with replicas stopped. The preceding published app ignores focus tables. Intermediate focus builds expecting public clocks or acknowledgement timestamps require matching schema rollback from coordinated backup; preserve newer focus sessions.
compatibility.clientVersions: Zero 1.11 clients require a 1.11 server; sync all pending edits before replacing 1.9 local databases and never clear storage or uninstall undrained offline clients. Reload web TOTP callers after upgrade/rollback; method-less 1.6 setup replies remain accepted. Browser/Android/desktop sessions and native approval protocols remain compatible except intentional password-reset revocation. New web bundles expose five provider pickers; old clients cannot parse saved version 2 bindings and retain legacy imports. Native browser import stays unavailable. Desktop earlier credential evidence needs online refresh; runtime qualification limits remain explicit. Legacy clients without interval IDs retain legacy logging. Interval-ID clients need the explicit observing-page monotonic proof marker for offline completion; old queued completions still require server evidence. Unqualified observers leave shared intervals unresolved for another tab/delayed sync, show notice after ten seconds and may Stop to discard. Personal legacy/offline focus records are not tamper-proof.

clients.note: Ship CLI/MCP/TUI JavaScript bundles for user-installed Bun 1.3.14+; document archive/checksum verification, MCP launch, JSON --version, BUILDINFO building-Bun identity, source URLs and notices/license texts covering every bundled or dependency-inlined package. The shebang uses --no-env-file and --config=/dev/null to prevent working-directory environment/preload injection. Minimum-version failure exits 2 and suffixes are tolerated. Scope is any Bun OS, qualified on Linux x64; rebuilds name tagged commit, building Bun and GNU tar. Commands, API envelopes, other exit codes and environment credentials remain unchanged. Standalone binary publication remains blocked/deferred.

public-api.note: Preserve minute, second and fractional-second ISO timestamp acceptance for task create/update/completion, observations and metadata. Offset-capable inputs retain explicit offsets or Z; UTC-only responses remain UTC-only. CSV retains acceptance and normalization. No API version or persisted format changes.
